column1: # B1183 (#502) legH: the LOOT row, with the corpse held long enough and
# placed IN FRONT of the caster's camera so the USE click lands on it.
# Why legG failed (measured, B1183 legG FINDINGS): #spawn puts the TrollF at
# the caster's own position -- directly under the third-person camera -- so
# its corpse is at/below the screen bottom and the (640,430) click hit
# nothing (22_kill frame: empty foreground, target frame stuck on the caster).
# This leg (1) holds the corpse via the server-SQL hook (EmptyNPCCorpseDecayTime
# 0 -> 300000, so it does not despawn ~1.03 s after OP_Death) and (2) moves the
# caster 3 units to -Y with heading 0 (EQ heading 0 = +Y/North, docs/CLAUDE.md
# "Heading/Rotation Conventions"), so the corpse (at +Y) is in front and large.
# The oracle writes 105 to the CORPSE's +0x251 (loot gate 28061/28062), not the
# looter's -- the poller's XNEW/XWR lines (non-local spawns) carry the corpse,
# the WR lines carry the looter (should hold 100).
# B1192 (#511): B1183 wrote this file SPACE-delimited; the session's
# CHARACTER was empty and legH3 died at the (then-silent) account_id check.
# This file is the same plan with real tabs.
